in_hebrew.name: Armallas
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mountain of strength
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Armallas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'armas' meaning 'mountain' and 'allas' meaning 'strength'. In Greek mythology, the name Armallas was given to a mighty warrior. In Christianity, it can be interpreted as a symbol of spiritual fortitude and endurance.
